hypothesis: higher partition heterogeneity (EMD) -> lower benefit from a shared model; tested one-sided
p_value_source: exact permutation null over partition orderings (stats_ordering), not the scipy asymptotic approximation
independence_note: Windows share an operator, a route set and a partitioning procedure, so they are not independent draws. Per-window p-values are reported separately, with the count of windows in which the ordering held, rather than pooled.
